format.description: Output format: BIN, STR, or SIV

outfile.description: Path to output file. If empty, defaults to stdout.

namespace.description: Namespace for version 3/5. Can be uuid, nil, max, ns:DNS, ns:URL, ns:OID, ns:X500, or a literal UUID.

ignore_mac.description: Ignore host MAC for v1/v6. Use random node ID if true.

independent.description: Generate v1 UUIDs independently (disable monotonic increment).
